The purpose of this overview is to: 1.. Briefly describe the clinical characteristics of hereditary ataxias (sometimes referred to as "primary hereditary ataxias") for which an adult with ataxia or the caregivers of a child with ataxia would seek diagnosis and management from a neurologist as part of a multidisciplinary team; 2.. Review common and notable genetic causes of hereditary ataxia; 3.. Provide an evaluation strategy to identify the genetic cause of hereditary ataxia in a proband; 4.. Review management of hereditary ataxia; 5.. Inform genetic counseling of family members of an individual with hereditary ataxia.
